step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an omnichannel Q&A and search platform built by American Heart Association using AWS services. Amazon Lex acts as the central conversational engine interacting with a combined Web Page / Bot user interface. Lex communicates via API Gateway to an Elasticsearch (OpenSearch) backend to perform full-text search across web properties and question-and-answer databases. Query and interaction data is processed by Lambda, which streams events into Kinesis Data Streams/Firehose for downstream analytics via Athena and external BI tools.

edges.notes: Lex updates and interacts with the web page and bot frame UI.
Lex sends search queries to API Gateway.
API Gateway routes search queries to Elasticsearch.
Elasticsearch interaction records pass to Lambda for processing.
Lambda forwards analytics event streams to Kinesis.
Kinesis feeds analytics data for querying via Athena.
